children: AutoNation amended and restated its unsecured credit agreement, raising the revolver to $2.0 billion and extending maturity to September 14, 2031.
Revolving credit commitment increased from $1.9B to $2.0B, providing more near-term liquidity.
Accordion capacity doubled to $1.0B (from $500M), allowing up to $1.0B additional borrowing subject to conditions.
Commitment fees and loan margins are same or lower than prior agreement, preserving or improving borrowing cost terms.
Maturity extended to Sept. 14, 2031; financial covenants unchanged: max leverage 3.75x (step-up to 4.25x for acquisitions) and min interest coverage 3.00x.

title: AutoNation boosts revolving facility to $2.0B, ups accordion to $1.0B, extends credit line to 2031
